scope: actual static CLI checks, no model, business tool or browser run

commands.stdout:
usage: agentkit [-h]
                {list,doctor,inspect,scaffold,seed,demo,run,chat,eval} ...

Reusable modular Agent starter kit

positional arguments:
  {list,doctor,inspect,scaffold,seed,demo,run,chat,eval}
    list                List available agents
    doctor              Check local Python dependencies and an agent spec
    inspect             Inspect config/source status without importing tools
                        or connecting models
    scaffold            Generate a new agent package
    seed                Create synthetic support ticket data
    demo                Offline deterministic business-logic demonstration
    run                 Run a real LLM-backed agent (requires model)
    chat                Run a real LLM-backed agent (requires model)
    eval                Run live LLM eval; NEVER auto-approve writes

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
